title: Good Faith & Price Estimates: Estimate Types, Coverage Answers and Channels
content:
Every estimate furnished under Good Faith & Price Estimates is one of seven estimate types. The type is fixed by the coverage answer the patient gives at the coverage inquiry and by the scope of the service being estimated.

**Coverage answers.** *Uninsured*: the patient has no coverage. *Self-pay elected*: the patient has coverage but chooses not to use it for this service. *Insured*: the patient has coverage and it is to be billed.

## Estimate types

| Estimate type | Coverage answers admitted | Scope of the service | No Surprises Act good faith estimate | Notice of the right to a good faith estimate given | Benefits and remaining deductible verified with the payer before issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Single Scheduled Service | uninsured; self-pay elected | one scheduled item or service furnished by Riverbend alone | yes | yes | no |
| Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Procedure with Co-Providers | uninsured; self-pay elected | a scheduled procedure with co-provider items (anesthesia, pathology, radiology) | yes | yes | no |
| Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Recurring Course of Care | uninsured; self-pay elected | recurring items or services over a course of up to 12 months | yes | yes | no |
| Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate | insured | a scheduled service billed to the patient's coverage | no | no | yes |
| Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Imaging & Diagnostics | uninsured; self-pay elected | a service code on the imaging package schedule | yes | yes | no |
| Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery | uninsured; self-pay elected | a service code on the outpatient surgery package schedule, ASA physical status I or II | yes | yes | no |
| Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery | uninsured; self-pay elected | global maternity care enrolled before 28 weeks of gestation | yes | yes | no |

## Inquiry and channels (identical on all seven types)

| Item | Value on every estimate type listed above |
|---|---|
| Scheduler asks whether the patient has coverage and whether they intend to use it | yes |
| Channels through which an estimate may be requested | scheduling call, patient portal, price estimate line, in person |
| Channels through which the estimate is delivered (paper or electronic, at the patient's choice) | US mail, patient portal, email link |

## Reading the table

- An insured patient who asks that the claim not be submitted gives the self-pay elected answer, and so falls under one of the six types that admit it rather than under the Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate.
- Only the Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate is not a No Surprises Act good faith estimate, and it is also the only type on which no rights notice is given and on which benefits are verified with the payer before issue.
- Example (hypothetical): an uninsured patient booking a screening study whose code is on the imaging package schedule holds a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Imaging & Diagnostics; the same patient booking a procedure with an anesthesia item and no package code holds a Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Procedure with Co-Providers.
